# Lessig-ish Style

> A SOMA app: a builder and presenter for Lessig-style presentations — one word/idea per
> slide, revealed in time with the narration. An unaffiliated homage to Lawrence Lessig's
> "Lessig Method." Wonderful to watch, historically hard to build; this makes it fast.

## Pages
- / : landing (itself a Lessig-ish scroll deck)
- /present.html : the word-on-voice presenter demo (ElevenLabs narration + live speed control)
- /about.html : the Lessig Method, Lawrence Lessig, and an open invitation for him to connect

## Feedback
- Every page carries the SOMA feedback chip (bottom-left) → the shared SOMA review queue.

## Built with
- SomaScript (the SOMA scripting language) + SomaCut (the render engine). Part of SOMA
  (Society of Minds Aligned). Contact: mw@mike-wolf.com
